content.value: At node X, there is a text file containing all the dates(01012026...31122026) of the (23) [CO3] year 2026, written sequentially with no spaces or any other symbols within dates or between the dates. Is it possible to encode the information in the text file in such a way that the information can be transmitted through the network to node Y within 5 minutes?
